caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man with short, dark, wavy hair and prominent sideburns, set against a plain beige background. The bust is dressed in a dark green double-breasted coat with a high red and yellow collar. A broad, diagonally-striped sash in red, white, and black runs from the right shoulder to the left waist, overlaid with a red and yellow cross-shaped medal at the chest. There is a large, star-shaped gold medal with a circular center on the left side of the chest. The man's facial features are detailed, with visible shading to indicate the contours of the face, nose, and lips. The bust stands on a green round pedestal base. The composition is centered on the page, with a thin double-lined border framing the image. The artist's signature, "Mina Lowry," is visible in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Portrait Bust
